title: DPC IPO lockup ends — DPC Holdings, 180 days after its 2026-06-24 prospectus
source: SEC: 424B4 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2107018/000110465926077968/tm269965-19_424b4.htm, fetched 2026-10-20 (scripts/research/lockup-discovery.mjs). Prospectus dated 2026-06-24 (read from its cover); 180 days after it is 2026-12-21. Lock-up clause: "See "Shares Eligible for Future Sale." Substantially all of these shares are also subject to lock-up agreements restricting their sale for 180 days after the date of this prospectus, as more fully described in "Underwriting." Jefferies LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co." Re-read 2026-11-21: the 424B4's lock-up covers 'the date 180 days after the date of this prospectus', states 'there are no agreements ... releasing them from these lock-up agreements prior to the expiration of the 180-day period', and has no earnings, price or blackout trigger; the Q3 10-Q (filed 2026-11-12, SEC:) restates 180 days from June 24, 2026. 2026-12-21 is the last locked day; the first session insiders may sell is Tuesday 2026-12-22.
notes: $919M offering at $33.00 (27.86M primary shares, all new; 2.08M concurrent private placement and QIA's 2.27M placement are separate). Insiders may sell from the next session, 2026-12-22; the pullback the lockup-expiry playbook studies (#5912) is the supply that unlocks then. Initial research: docs/research/events/dpc-lockup-expiry-2026-12-21.md.
